findings.priorityReason: This is the only finding that survived the admission gates. It ranks ahead of excluded candidates (parallelizing the two fs checks in validator.ts:113, tightening declaresExplicitNoDelta to isFile(), extending GUIDE_NO_DELTAS text, cleaning other dead exports) because it is the only one with (a) actual benefit — completing this change's own dead-code removal, (b) static evidence visible in the current file, and (c) fully closable preservation constraints. The excluded candidates fail admission: the fs.stat directory-name edge is literally permitted by the Requirement's wording ('change 目录存在 .delta-noop'), GUIDE_NO_DELTAS changes observable CLI output in a file (constants.ts) outside base scope, parallelization has no measurable benefit on a cold validation path, and other dead exports are an explicit design non-goal. Cost is a single-line deletion verified by the existing parity suite.
